name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP Suite
releaseNotes: v1.0.6: Moved Songs inside Music & SFX with interactive sub-filter pills and format dropdown (All, Songs, Albums, Artists, Playlists), native Apple Music song & album analyzer/downloader via zero-auth iTunes lookup, robust 1-click clipboard Paste button fallback, and resolved single-track playlist false detection.
Added Songs Studio search with 100M+ zero-auth keyless music catalog, artists, albums, and top tracks.
Custom API Key configuration in Settings: enter and save your personal Pexels & Pixabay API keys.
Dedicated Songs & Audio category filter tab in Search Studio.
High-fidelity MP3/WAV audio extractor and streaming engine.
